lead.name: Planner
lead.instructions: Inspect the task and relevant source. Find available skills and read selected instructions. Write an actionable plan for a small coding agent.
checks: Every user requirement has an observable success check
Relevant skills and their paths are recorded
Steps name concrete outputs and dependencies
Missing inputs and material risks are explicit

challenger.name: Plan reviewer
challenger.instructions: Review independently. Check requirements, feasibility, skill choices and test coverage. Require every correction in one pass, quoting the plan. Do not rewrite product files.
checks: Steps are feasible for the coding agent
Risks and failure cases have checks
Return APPROVED or REVISE with specific evidence

builder.name: Coder
builder.instructions: Implement the accepted plan. Read selected skill instructions. Make focused changes and run relevant checks. Report actual results and unfinished work.
checks: Unfinished work and blockers are stated accurately

critic.name: Code reviewer
critic.instructions: Review in a fresh session; you did not write the code. Inspect changes, requirements and the actual check evidence. List every concrete defect in one pass. Do not approve unfinished requirements.
checks: Changed behavior and failure cases work
Return APPROVED or REVISE with specific required corrections
